historical_references.reference: Divyansh was a legendary king, also known as Divyakumar, who ruled over the ancient city of Mahishmati during the Gupta Empire period. He is best remembered for his unwavering devotion to Lord Shiva.

Divyansh is also mentioned as the name of one of the sons of the great Hindu king Raja Raja Chola I, who ruled the Chola Empire from 1014 to 1044 CE. He is believed to have been a brave warrior and an able administrator.
